# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary architecture and analysis documents generated during assessment.

- [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory and risk summary.
- [API & Service Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) - Endpoints, contracts, and service communication flow.
- [Data Architecture](data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, data ownership, and ER diagram.
- [Configuration Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) - Externalized settings, profiles, and secrets handling.
- [Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) - Core business flows and decision logic.
